<!--
The shape is four headings and they are not optional. `docs/contracts/agent-copy.md`
is the rule behind them; this file is only the shape.

Keep the headings even where a section is short. A reviewer skimming a queue
finds the section they need by its position, and a body that drops one has
dropped the part the diff cannot supply.
-->

## Why was the change needed?

<!--
One or two sentences, or bullets. What a person could not do, or what was
wrong. Not what you did — that is below, and not where it was found.
-->

## What is the outcome of the change

<!--
Show the end result, as a person meets it: the sentence that now appears, the
screen that now draws, the command that now answers. An example beats a
description. Not a narration of the edits, and not the diff — the reader has
the diff.
-->

## Risks

<!--
What could still be wrong, what was deliberately left alone, and what the
obvious alternative fix would have cost. A caveat a reviewer cannot act on is
one they skim past, so give each one its cost and its way forward.
-->

## Checks Evidence

<!--
What proves this. Named commands and their results, and what the tests
actually drive. "Tests pass" proves nothing a reader can check.
-->
